```{r include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(imcRtools)
```

```{r}
steinbock_dir <- "/restricted/projectnb/camplab/home/tshah20/tumor_IMC/patient14_steinbock/"

# Patch panel file to match what steinbock wrote into intensities CSV
panel <- read_csv(file.path(steinbock_dir, "panel_GATA3.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
panel <- panel |>
  mutate(name = if_else(name == "TTF1orCD16", "TTForCD16", name))

patched_panel_path <- file.path(steinbock_dir, "panel_GATA3_patched.csv")
write_csv(panel, patched_panel_path)

spe <- read_steinbock(steinbock_dir, panel_file = "panel_GATA3_patched.csv")

raw_dir <- "/restricted/projectnb/camplab/home/tshah20/tumor_IMC/patient14_steinbock/raw/"

raw_files <- list.files(raw_dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

coord_cols <- c("Start_push", "End_push", "Pushes_duration", "X", "Y", "Z")

txt_cols <- names(read_tsv(raw_files[1], show_col_types = FALSE))
marker_cols <- txt_cols[!txt_cols %in% coord_cols]

txt_to_marker <- setNames(
  str_extract(marker_cols, "^[^(]+"),
  marker_cols
)

pre_seg <- map_dfr(raw_files, function(f) {
  df <- read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
  roi <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  df |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -any_of(coord_cols),
                 names_to = "channel", values_to = "intensity") |>
    mutate(
      channel = recode(channel, !!!txt_to_marker),
      channel = if_else(channel == "TTF1orCD16", "TTForCD16", channel),
      roi = roi,
      source = "pre_segmentation"
    )
}) |>
  filter(channel %in% rownames(spe))

post_seg <- assay(spe, "counts") |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("channel") |>
  pivot_longer(-channel, names_to = "cell_id", values_to = "intensity") |>
  mutate(
    roi = str_remove(cell_id, "_\\d+$"),
    source = "post_segmentation"
  )

combined <- bind_rows(pre_seg, post_seg) |>
  filter(channel %in% rownames(spe))
```


```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
# ---- pre_vs_post_seg_plot ----
library(patchwork)

markers <- rownames(spe)
plots <- list()

for (m in markers) {
  plot_df <- combined |> filter(channel == m)

  plots[[m]] <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = intensity, fill = source, color = source)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, quantile(plot_df$intensity, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("pre_segmentation" = "#4E79A7", "post_segmentation" = "#F28E2B"),
                      labels = c("pre_segmentation" = "Pre (pixel)", "post_segmentation" = "Post (cell mean)")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("pre_segmentation" = "#4E79A7", "post_segmentation" = "#F28E2B"),
                       labels = c("pre_segmentation" = "Pre (pixel)", "post_segmentation" = "Post (cell mean)")) +
    labs(title = m, x = "Intensity", y = "Density", fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}

for (i in seq(1, length(plots), by = 2)) {
  if (i + 1 <= length(plots)) {
    print(plots[[i]] + plots[[i + 1]])
  } else {
    print(plots[[i]])
  }
}
```
